idea_name: Algo Forge multi-repo Git workflow tutorial only
mechanism: MetaEditor Shared Projects clone, branch, include-path fix, and Pull Request merge for library+EA repositories; no market feature extraction.
why_new_for_mis: After full read: pure VCS/integration tooling; no regime, volatility, liquidity, or neural sensing.
quote: Overall, the workflow with personal repositories is now well established. We have covered the path from cloning repositories to refining a process where changes leave the code functional and ready for further development.

idea_name: LSTM-VAE latent memory forced by multi-bar reconstruction stack
mechanism: Recurrent encoder (OpenCL CNeuronLSTMOCL) ingests only the latest 10×12 bar feature vector per step; a rolling stack of past encoder inputs becomes the decoder target (up to ~40 bars), so reconstruction loss forces use of LSTM memory/hidden state rather than identity mapping of the current window.
data_needed: Sequential bar feature windows (12 features × 10 bars into encoder); reconstruction target stack of prior normalized states; unsupervised VAE loss.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; last 15 years; default indicator settings; encoder last 10 candles, decoder restores ~40.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an unsupervised sequence latent whose capacity is explicitly stress-tested to hold multi-dozen prior market states—usable as a compressed history sensor without labels.
quote: If the stack size exceeds the value of the initial data at the encoder input, the autoencoder will have to look into the memory of past states.

idea_name: Latent-state horizon as retained-history depth sensor
mechanism: After unsupervised training, author reports the LSTM-VAE latent retains information about ≥30 prior iterations while encoder sees only 10 bars per step; treat latent activation / reconstruction quality over lag as a measure of how far back the market path remains compressible.
data_needed: Trained rnn_vae weights; rolling feed of closed H1 bars; optional lag-wise reconstruction probes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1, ~15y sample; 20 epochs to <9% loss in reported test.
why_new_for_mis: Turns autoencoder memory horizon into an explicit sensing quantity: how much recent path structure is still encoded—orthogonal to labeled direction models.
quote: Also, information about at least 30 previous iterations is stored in the latent state of the model.

idea_name: Transfer-learned VAE encoder to fractal Buy/Sell/Undefine sensor
mechanism: Copy frozen/pretrained encoder (fully-connected or LSTM VAE) plus batch-norm into a new net; append dense decision layers (2×500 tanh + 3-way sigmoid) and supervise on fractal labels: buy if local low vs neighbors, sell if local high, else undefine; train chronologically on H1 with RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD+OHLC-delta/time features.
data_needed: EURUSD H1 OHLC, tick_volume/1000, hour/dow/month, RSI14, CCI14, ATR14, MACD(12,26,9); fractal boolean targets on bar i; donor .nnw encoder file.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; StudyPeriod=2 years; HistoryBars derived from input layer/12.
why_new_for_mis: MIS can reuse unsupervised market compressors as frozen feature front-ends for a three-way swing/no-swing neural sensor with measured faster convergence vs random init.
quote: the best performance was shown by the model with a pre-trained recurrent encoder. Its error decreased at a significantly faster rate practically from the first training epochs.

idea_name: Neighbor-fractal swing label as local extremum change sensor
mechanism: Label bar i as sell when high[i-1]<=high[i] and high[i+1]<high[i], buy when low[i-1]>=low[i] and low[i+1]>low[i], else undefine; used as supervised target and as live forecast metric (dForecast/dUndefine).
data_needed: Three consecutive H1 highs/lows around the labeled bar.
why_new_for_mis: Provides a simple, non-indicator local-extremum change label that MIS can emit alongside neural outputs as a structural pivot/no-pivot regime bit.
quote:
bool sell = (Rates[i - 1].high <= Rates[i].high && Rates[i + 1].high < Rates[i].high);
            bool buy = (Rates[i - 1].low >= Rates[i].low && Rates[i + 1].low > Rates[i].low);

mechanism: In MHSparseAttentionScore, after Query·Key scores and before SoftMax, raise a dynamic min threshold until only active_units≈max(units*sparse,3) elements remain; zero others. Sparse=0.3 (keep ~30%) across heads; zero scores skipped in Out and backward kernels.
data_needed: Sequence of compressed bar tokens (article: 20 units×5 features after conv stack); per-head Q/K; sparsity hyperparameter in (0,1].
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1, March 2023 tester run; HistoryBars×12 bar features + 9 account-state inputs.
why_new_for_mis: Exposes which historical tokens each attention head deems influential—usable as a sparse significance mask over deep quote history without full quadratic SoftMax cost.
quote: we can use the heuristic of the "80/20" Pareto rule, where we take only 20% of the most significant elements from the total sequence. The significance of elements is determined based on the coefficients of dependence between elements

idea_name: Sparse-attention FQF policy stack as sequence trading sensor
mechanism: Model path: Base(HistoryBars*12+9)→BatchNorm→Conv/Dense compress→CNeuronMLMHSparseAttention (20 units, 4 heads, 2 layers, probability=0.3)→Fully parameterized Quantile Function head with 4 actions (buy/sell/close/idle); trained online in tester with ICM relational RL stack from prior parts.
data_needed: Closed-bar feature window + account state; OpenCL NeuroNet sparse attention layer; FQF action-value heads.
why_new_for_mis: Packages sparse long-history attention with a distributional action head into one deployable MQL5 sequence sensor for directional vs idle decisions.
quote: To analyze the data, we will use 4 attention heads, selecting 30% of the most significant sequence elements in each attention head.

idea_name: Rule-based multi-pattern OHLC candlestick sensor microservice
mechanism: MQL5 EA posts last 31 closed bars OHLC JSON to local Flask /patterns; Python detect_patterns labels each bar as doji (|body|≤10% range), hammer (lower≥2×body, upper≤body), shootingstar (mirror), bullish/bearish engulfing, harami, morning/evening star (3-candle midpoint rules); EA draws labels and Alerts.
data_needed: Symbol OHLC arrays for BARS=31 on InpTF; HTTP to 127.0.0.1:5000/patterns.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 (logged test); Crash 1000 also shown; InpTF configurable.
why_new_for_mis: Delivers a low-latency, library-free catalog of classic PA morphologies as discrete sensing events MIS can count, gate, or fuse with regime models.
quote: Our custom detect_patterns(df) routine scans each row for Doji, Hammer, Shooting Star, Engulfing, Harami, Morning Star, and Evening Star signals, no external TA libraries needed.

idea_name: Doji body/range ratio as bar-level indecision sensor
mechanism: Flag doji when abs(close-open) ≤ (high-low)*0.1 (≤10% of full range); treated as neither-buyers-nor-sellers control within the bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 in live log (multiple dojis counted); same rule for any TF OHLC fed to the server.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a crisp, parameter-light indecision bit on each bar that is independent of indicator lag and complementary to trend/vol sensors.
quote: If the body is less than or equal to 10% of the candle range, it's considered a Doji.

idea_name: Morning/Evening Star three-bar reversal morphology sensor
mechanism: Morning: long bearish, small middle body (<50% of first body) with gap-ish overlap, third bullish close above midpoint of first; Evening: mirror bullish→small→bearish close below midpoint. Emitted as named pattern on completing bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 test stream; Crash 1000 chart demo.
why_new_for_mis: Provides an explicit multi-bar sentiment-flip change event (not just single-candle wick ratios) that MIS can use as a discrete reversal candidate sensor.
quote: This is a three-candle reversal pattern, usually signaling the end of a downtrend.

idea_name: Weekend gap boundary and size sensor
mechanism: Detect weekend discontinuity when consecutive bar time delta ≥172800s; gapHigh/gapLow = max/min(Friday close, Monday open); gap direction isGapDown if Fri close > Mon open; size in pips via PipSize(); filter by MinGapPips / MinTradableGapPips.
data_needed: Symbol open/close/time series spanning Fri→Mon; pip size from digits.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-symbol/multi-TF validation stated; EURUSD example chart; works on any chart TF that leaves a ≥2-day hole.
why_new_for_mis: Formalizes calendar-driven price discontinuity as a first-class MIS feature (direction, bounds, tradable size)—not a continuous-session indicator.
quote: A gap is recognized when the time difference between two consecutive bars is at least 172800 seconds, which corresponds to two full days.

idea_name: Gap-fill progress and fill-complete change sensor
mechanism: While gap unfilled within week window (until next Monday), track whether candle range touches opposite boundary (CandleTouchesLevel); on touch set gapFilled and stop new signals. Fill-toward-trade: gap-down buy when close confirms above gapLow (+optional ConfirmationOffsetPips); gap-up sell when close confirms below gapHigh.
data_needed: Active GapInfo (bounds, isGapDown); per-bar high/low/close until next Monday or fill.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/TF with weekend gaps; EURUSD illustrated; MaxHistoricalWeeks default 26.
why_new_for_mis: Turns gap closure itself into a timed change sensor (approaching vs filled) with closed-bar confirmation—usable for liquidity-reopen / imbalance-repair monitoring.
quote: Rather than waiting for the gap to be fully closed before taking action, traders may seek to participate in the expected movement toward the fill.

idea_name: In-week extreme structure for gap-trade risk bounds
mechanism: As bars print inside the gap week, update weekHigh/weekLow; PublishSignal sets TP at opposite gap edge and SL at weekLow−buffer (buy) or weekHigh+buffer (sell); expose via six CopyBuffer channels (buy/sell arrow, TP, SL).
data_needed: Running week extremes since Monday open; StopBufferPips; confirmed signal bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart symbol/period of attachment; multi-symbol tests mentioned.
why_new_for_mis: Couples weekend gap geometry to evolving weekly structure extremes as a joint entry/risk sensing package MIS or an EA can read without repainting.
quote: The stop-loss level is placed at the most recently established swing low within the current trading week… The take-profit target is set at the upper gap boundary, which corresponds to the previous Friday close
